products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-CAM-OV5640
products.hardwareRevision: V1/V1.1 shared software; shipped revision unspecified
products.summary: 16 MiB Flash / 8 MiB PSRAM摄像头主控；四种传感器选件独立，音频控制和BOOT/PWR数字子集。

interfaces.name: TF · native1-bit SDMMC
interfaces.notes: 默认准备64MiB FAT32；CH32门控和SD总线未接入客体；镜像仅保留在本地。

limitations: Exact four sensor SKU identities retained; only shared ES8311/ES7210 control ports plus BOOT/PWR implemented. No camera SCCB/DVP, sensor chip ID, capture frame, CH32 IO/power emulation or optional LCD.
A physical TF slot is declared and prepared64MiBFAT32 retained locally; guest native-SD transport is not attached because CH32 mode/power gating has not been implemented.
Plain manufacturer Factory.bin contains all four named camera drivers and is separate from LCD_1_83/2/2_8/3_5 images; original sensor detection/boot behavior remains unverified for each SKU.
No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.

The supplied controller STEP is shared by OV5640,OV3660,GC2145,GC0308 storefront choices; separate sensor flex/lens assemblies are absent from the supplied CAD and are not fabricated. Exact four SKU photographs retained.
Native CAD component side placement is retained as supplied; diagram/photo alignment and exact shipped revision remain partial, not a dimensional guarantee.
BOOT/PWR remain actual product controls; CAD switch electrical identity/face orientation has not been calibrated as a 3D hit region.
No optional LCD is included in these camera SKUs. Source CAD includes the vacant camera connector and microSD slot; sensor frames and guest SD transport remain unmodeled.
Official firmware trial is not proof of successful startup or full compatibility; no physical hardware test.

chronology.notes: 官方发布日期未确认；目录位置用于优先队列，不作为发布日期。
